'''2000 Dagobah Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Dagobah region (Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00dagobah">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=dagobah 2000 Regionals: Dagobah], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726144713/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=dagobah Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Charlie Herren]] of Miami, Florida won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Date:''' 29 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Villager Lodge Jacksonville, Florida

== Decklists ==
* [[2000 Dagobah Regionals Mike Fitzgerald Burn Him Before Me]] ([[Mike Fitzgerald]], [[Dark]]; 4–0) — "This deck went 4-0 with a +55 differential at the Dagobah Regional for me."
* [[2000 Dagobah Regionals Adam Beauchamp Machine Ralltiir Ops]] ([[Adam Beauchamp]], [[Dark]]) — Team Machine's list; "Charlie Herren won with it" (his copy swapped a few cards).
